newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Wednesday July 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Wednesday July 16.

text.p: The following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.

* The Italian fashion world was shocked following the murder of fashion guru Gianni Versace. A show to end Rome's "alta moda" (haute couture) fashion week which was to have taken place on Rome's Spanish Steps on Wednesday was called off after news of the slaying. (all)

* Discussions between the government, trades union leaders and business federations on reforming the Italian pension system began on Tuesday. Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi cautioned that all sides should avoid "false moves" in the tricky negotiations to slash Italy's budget deficit. (all)

* According to the government, Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi and Bank of Italy Governor Antonio Fazio had a "long and cordial meeting" on Tuesday in what seemed a detente over a long-running dispute on interest rates. Prodi has often disagreed with Fazio over the recent high cost of borrowing. (all)
* The Finance Ministry has produced guidelines to help tax collectors stop evasion. New rules will allow investigators tighter controls on those not paying taxes. (all)
** Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
